lede: Houston carries the stronger underlying team rating — +6.0 against +4.1, a 2.0-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Houston -9.3 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Houston winning 74% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is qb room, where Houston leads UCF by 93 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 88% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
